Layout and rasterization of OgImage via nvg.

Fixed layout grid on 1200x630: badge, title box (ellipsis, 3 lines), description box (ellipsis, 2 lines), footer row. Text never auto-shrinks; overflow trims with "..." instead.

types, theme, fonts

proc createFittedImage(c: Canvas; path: string; dispW, dispH: float64;
                       factor = 2.0; flags: set[ImageFlag] = {}): int {.
    ...raises: [Exception, ValueError], tags: [ReadIOEffect, RootEffect],
    forbids: [].}
Load path and upload it at factorx the drawn size. nvg image patterns sample one bilinear tap with no mipmaps, so drawing a large source at a small size aliases (thin icon strokes break up); area-averaging down to a modest oversample here keeps coverage even. Sources at or below the target upload as-is. Returns 0 for missing/undecodable files, like createImageFile. SVG has no decoder in nvg: vector paths always fail here.
